name: Security Baseline
description: Enforce security governance rules for architecture-level threat mitigation

rules.name: No Public Services Without API Gateway
rules.description: All public-facing services must sit behind an API gateway. Direct exposure creates an uncontrolled attack surface without centralized auth, rate limiting, or logging.

config.message: Public-facing service must be accessed through an API gateway. Direct public exposure is not allowed.

rules.name: External Dependencies Must Be Documented
rules.description: All external system dependencies must be modeled as explicit relationships. Undocumented external dependencies are invisible risks for security reviews and incident response.

config.message: External dependency must be documented as an explicit relationship with a description.

rules.name: Database Not Publicly Accessible
rules.description: Database containers must not be directly accessible from outside the system boundary. All database access must go through an application service.

config.message: Database container must not have direct relationships from external systems. Route access through application services.

rules.name: Authentication as Separate Service
rules.description: Authentication must be implemented as a dedicated, separate container. Embedding auth logic into business services makes it harder to audit, rotate credentials, and enforce consistent policies.

config.message: Architecture must include a dedicated authentication container. Do not embed auth into business services.

rules.name: No Secrets in Container Configuration
rules.description: Container descriptions and configurations must not contain secrets, credentials, or connection strings. Secrets must be managed through a dedicated secrets manager or vault.

config.message: Container configuration must not contain secrets. Use a secrets manager or vault service.

rules.name: External API Calls Must Be Documented
rules.description: All outbound calls to external APIs must be modeled as explicit relationships with descriptions. This enables security review of data flows crossing trust boundaries.

config.message: External API call must be documented as a relationship with a description of data exchanged.

rules.name: Encryption Technology for Data at Rest
rules.description: Database containers must have encryption technology specified, ensuring data at rest is protected by design.

config.message: Database container must have encryption technology specified for data-at-rest protection.

rules.name: Network Segmentation Between Layers
rules.description: Presentation layer containers must not directly access data layer containers. Network segmentation between layers limits blast radius in case of compromise.

config.message: Presentation layer must not directly access data layer. Route through application/service layer for network segmentation.
